name: browser_open
title: Open a browser
description: Open a headless Chromium for this agent session, on a fresh profile that Berth deletes when the browser closes. Returns the CDP endpoint and the path of a file holding its token; connect with any CDP client (for example Playwright's connectOverCDP) and send the file's content in the X-Berth-Token header. At most 2 open and 10 opened an hour; the browser closes with browser_close or when this agent session ends.

name: browser_close
title: Close a browser
description: Close one browser this agent session opened with browser_open, and delete its profile and token file.

name: browser_list
title: List my browsers
description: List the open browsers of this agent session (ids, states, CDP endpoints), for example to find and close them after a restart. Tokens are not shown again.

name: secret_list
title: List secret names
description: List the names of the secrets stored in Berth. Values are never shown to agents.

name: secret_request
title: Request a secret
description: Ask the person to store a secret under a name, through a native dialog they type into. Returns only whether it was stored; the value never reaches the agent. The person sees the reason labelled as the agent's claim.

why.description: Why the agent needs it, shown to the person
